project: BTC ATM Short Straddle Trading System

endpoints_used.name: BTC Spot/Perp Ticker
endpoints_used.purpose: Feeds live BTC price, 24h high/low, and 24h percentage change to BtcPriceCard

endpoints_used.name: BTC 15-Minute Kline
endpoints_used.purpose: Renders real-time 24-point sparkline price chart in the BTC Price card

endpoints_used.name: Option Instruments Info
endpoints_used.purpose: Discovers all active BTC option expirations, strikes, and contract specifications

endpoints_used.name: Option Top-of-Book Tickers
endpoints_used.purpose: Fetches mark price, bids, and asks to seed option orderbooks

endpoints_used.name: Unified Account Wallet Balance
endpoints_used.authentication: HMAC-SHA256 signature with API Key, timestamp, and recv_window
endpoints_used.purpose: Displays real wallet balance, used margin, and available USDT in AccountBalanceCard

endpoints_used.name: NautilusTrader Order Execution
endpoints_used.purpose: Submits IOC limit orders to Bybit Demo Trading and handles order fills/cancels

endpoints.description: Returns full snapshot: state, selected strike, live quotes, positions, and Level 2 risk metrics
Returns chronological audit log events from the strategy engine
Returns live BTC price, 24h change, high, low, and 15m sparkline history
Returns authenticated Bybit Unified Trading Account wallet balance
Arms the strategy and executes ATM short straddle entry orders
Disarms the strategy back to QUOTING state
Emergency exit: buys back both option legs with reduce-only orders and transitions to CLOSED
Dynamically updates strategy configuration (SL %, TP %, qty, max spread)
Bi-directional WebSocket streaming real-time snapshots and execution events to the frontend

level_2_risk_management.rule: Automated Risk Management according to assignment specifications
level_2_risk_management.stop_loss_description: Close both positions when combined buyback cost increases by 1% from entry premium
level_2_risk_management.take_profit_description: Close both positions when combined buyback cost decreases by 2% from entry premium
